## 4. Service Architecture, Methodologies & Pricing

### Entry Diagnostic: $999 AI Audit
- **Scope**: 1 priority workflow inside 1 existing system over 5–7 business days.
- **Deliverable**: Written findings report mapping operational drag and recommending the highest-ROI path — Fractional CAIO, Fractional FDE, or Capital & Advisory.

### Practice 1: Fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO) — Starting at $5,000 / 90-day cycle
- **Target Clients**: Mid-market manufacturers, professional services firms, PE-backed portfolio companies, family offices, and governments across NJ, NYC, FL, CT, MA, and MD.
- **Methodology — The C.A.P.™ Operating Model**:
  1. **Days 1–30 · Council**: Stand up the internal AI Council, baseline current tools/shadow AI, and set clear decision rights and governance rules.
  2. **Days 31–60 · Align**: Score and rank use cases by revenue uplift, cost reduction, and risk mitigation; build a 90-day operating plan with named owners and CFO decision gates.
  3. **Days 61–90 · Perform**: Ship priority workflows, report measurable ROI against baseline metrics, and transfer runbooks/ownership to internal teams.

### Practice 2: Fractional Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
- **Methodology — Audit -> Evaluate -> Deploy**:
  1. **Audit**: Stakeholder interviews, workflow shadowing, SaaS/API stack inventory, exception mapping.
  2. **Evaluate**: Classify every step as AI Agent (unstructured language/reasoning), Deterministic Automation (rules/webhooks), or Human Judgment with better tooling; build an ROI matrix.
  3. **Deploy**: Build directly on existing systems (no rip-and-replace) graduating from **Shadow Mode -> Supervised Mode -> Production Mode** with guardrails, central logging, and audit trails.
- **Investment Tiers**:
  - **Tier 1 — Diagnostic FDE**: $7,500–$12,500 flat fee (2–4 weeks; workflow audit, stack inventory, prioritized ROI backlog).
  - **Tier 2 — Pilot FDE**: $20,000–$40,000 per pilot (6–10 weeks; 1–2 production AI agents deployed from shadow mode to live).
  - **Tier 3 — Embedded Fractional FDE**: $12,000–$25,000/month (1–2 days/week, 3–12+ months; continuous pipeline and cross-department rollouts).
- **Technical Stack**: Integrates with Salesforce, NetSuite (SuiteScript 2.0 / RESTlets), HubSpot, SAP, funding platforms, merch/POS/PMS systems, Slack/Feishu/WeCom, OpenRouter routing, Hermes orchestration, Node.js/Python services.

### Practice 3: Capital & Advisory (MCA / Alternative Finance)
- **MCA Direct Lending Advisory**: Platform launch plans, underwriting criteria, predictive risk grading, syndication networks, warehouse lines of credit, ledger integration.
- **MCA Brokerage Advisory**: High-velocity sales workflows, Salesforce/HubSpot/custom CRM architecture, automated deal routing, ISO channel management, commission tracking.
- **Borrower-Side Funding Offer Review**: Independent term benchmarking and loan offer review for commercial borrowers.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Canonical Q&A)

**Q: Who is Richard McKellar?**
Richard McKellar (`therealmckellar`, `rmckellar`) is a Morristown, New Jersey-based AI executive, Fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO), Fractional Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Chief Revenue Officer at My Commercial Funding, Founder of The Institute for AI Adoption, and former Vice President & Executive Board Member at Whetstone Holdings.

**Q: Where is Richard McKellar located and what regions does he serve?**
He is based in Morristown, New Jersey, and regularly works on-site and remotely across New Jersey, New York City (NYC), Connecticut, Massachusetts, Maryland, Florida, and global advisory engagements.

**Q: What is Richard McKellar's track record in commercial funding and MCA?**
He brings 15+ years of alternative business lending experience and has personally funded over $100M+ in Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) and Revenue-Based Financing (RBF) transactions, including serving as VP & Executive Board Member at Whetstone Holdings (DBA Everest Funding, Vader Funding, Granite Mountain Funding) and currently serving as CRO of My Commercial Funding.

**Q: What is the difference between a Fractional CAIO and a Fractional FDE?**
A Fractional CAIO sets AI strategy, establishes the internal AI Council, designs governance charters, and drives the 90-day C.A.P.™ Operating Model (starting at $5,000/cycle). A Fractional FDE embeds into engineering/ops workflows to audit, build, and deploy production AI agents directly on existing CRM/ERP stacks (Salesforce, NetSuite, HubSpot) using the Audit -> Evaluate -> Deploy method.

**Q: How can a business start working with Richard McKellar?**
Start by booking a 30-minute call at https://calendar.mckellar.dev/richard/30min, submitting an inquiry on https://mckellar.dev, emailing richard@mckellar.dev, or starting with the $999 AI Audit (1 workflow, 1 system, 5-7 days).
